name: cypress-demo
description: The Multimodal Madness: Cypress Ambassador 2026 demo (AI Playground + cypress-ai-vitals)

scripts.test: start-server-and-test app http://localhost:4400/health "cypress run --browser chrome --expose grepTags=-@needs-cloud+-@real-web"
scripts.test:record: AI_MODE=record start-server-and-test app http://localhost:4400/health "cypress run --browser chrome --expose grepTags=-@needs-cloud+-@real-web"
scripts.test:replay: AI_MODE=replay start-server-and-test app http://localhost:4400/health "cypress run --browser chrome --expose grepTags=-@needs-cloud+-@real-web"
scripts.test:cloud: start-server-and-test app http://localhost:4400/health "cypress run --browser chrome --expose grepTags=@needs-cloud"
scripts.test:real: start-server-and-test app http://localhost:4400/health "cypress run --browser chrome --spec 'cypress/e2e/real-demo/*.cy.ts' --expose grepTags=-@needs-cloud"
